sentence: The Douro Wine Company ( also known as General Company of Agriculture of Wines of Upper Douro in Portuguese Companhia Geral da Agricultura e Vinhos do Alto Douro ) was government oversight organization established by Portuguese Prime Minister Sebastio Jos de Carvalho e Melo , Marquis of Pombal to regulate trade production of Port wine .

subject: Douro Wine Company
sentence: Established in 1756 , one of first official duties of company was delineation of boundaries of Douro wine region . This act essentially made Douro worlds first regional appellation . While boundaries of Chianti Tokaji wine regions were outlined in 1716 1737 , respectively , neither of these regions were technically appellations in sense of being subjected to continued government control regulations . Under their charter , Pombal invested immense amount of control in Douro Wine Company to regulate all exports of Port , set production quantities limits , fix maximum minimum prices for grapes to serve as sole arbitrator in any disputes between vine growers Port shippers . In 1761 , company was further granted monopoly on sale of brandy which was used in fortification process of Port winemaking . The Douro Wine Company continued to operate to 1833 ( was briefly revived from 1843 1853 ) . Today , many of it functions have been deregulated with Instituto dos Vinhos do Douro e do Porto or ( Port Douro Wines Institute ) being official regulating body of Port wine Douro table wine production . He received proprietorship after death of his father , George Calvert , 1st Baron Baltimore , ( 1579 – 15 April 1632 ) , for whom it had been intended . Cecil Calvert established managed Province of Maryland from his home , Kiplin Hall , in North Yorkshire , England . As English Roman Catholic , he continued legacy of his father by promoting religious tolerance in colony . Maryland became haven for Catholics in New World , particularly important at time of religious persecution in England . Calvert governed Maryland for forty-two years . He also continued to be Lord Proprietor Governor of Newfoundland for Province of Avalon .
